mapper.select: SELECT id, callback_type, provider_class, provider_config, description, status, create_time, update_time FROM ai_tool_callback_config WHERE callback_type = #{callbackType} AND status = 1
SELECT id, callback_type, provider_class, provider_config, description, status, create_time, update_time FROM ai_tool_callback_config WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_tool_callback_config (callback_type, provider_class, provider_config, description, status) VALUES (#{callbackType}, #{providerClass}, #{providerConfig}, #{description}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_tool_callback_config SET callback_type = #{callbackType}, provider_class = #{providerClass}, provider_config = #{providerConfig}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
